verdict.rationale: Daily's docs say its server-side REST API can "control calls from your server," which is a direct but generic claim matching this story. None of the specific operations are documented in the evidence. Server-side event webhooks are a different capability and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented endpoint to list active sessions, server-side mute of participants, server-side removal/eject of participants, server-side end-session call, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop

citations.quote: Create rooms, manage tokens, trigger recordings, and control calls from your server.
